business_problem: Miral wanted a better way to answer the large volume of visitor questions about Yas Island experiences because traditional bots often failed to satisfy customer needs.
solution_summary: Miral used Microsoft Azure to extend its Noor Analytics initiative into a generative AI concierge for Yas Island visitors. The company built the Majd AI ambassador on Azure OpenAI Service so guests can describe preferences, family needs, and trip goals in natural language and receive personalized recommendations for attractions, dining, shopping, and timing. Because the public website lets anyone ask any question, Miral worked through prompt engineering, architecture reviews, and guardrails to reduce the risk of inappropriate responses and reputational damage. The concierge went from proof of concept to production in two months, runs continuously as a 24/7 digital guide, and escalates complex requests to human agents when needed.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Powers the Majd AI concierge that answers visitor questions and generates personalized recommendations.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Search
solution_components.role: Supports retrieval of relevant destination and attraction information for the concierge experience.

solution_components.name: Azure
solution_components.role: Provides the secure cloud foundation for Miral’s data-driven and generative AI workloads.

business_outcome: Within the first week of launch, Miral’s AI chatbot completed more than 1,700 operations, and within about two months transfers to human agents dropped by 3%, helping the call center focus on unique queries.
